description: List recent AI coding assistant sessions as structural metadata only: session id, assistant, timestamps, message and tool counts, and token totals. No session message text is returned, and no label authored inside a transcript such as a project name, git branch or model id. hours bounds the window, limit caps the row count, project, cli and user narrow the list; a row from a Compliance API export carries the recorded user id and never the email address. compliance_withheld counts the Compliance API export sessions that were found and withheld unread because reading them needs an Enterprise license; they contribute no row.

cli.description: Only sessions recorded by this assistant, for example claude, codex or cursor.

hours.description: Only sessions active in the last N hours. 0 lists all history. Default 168.

project.description: Only sessions whose project name or path matches this filter.

user.description: Only sessions whose user id or email address matches this filter; only a Compliance API export carries either.

name: list_sessions
title: List recent sessions
